answer: Duplicate identities cannot reuse the same plume without burning their jade stake, so a sybil swarm must pay the full stake per fake node. Each agent must stake a jade token at a registered jetty checkpoint, where a plume signature is bound to its hardware. Attackers thus face linear cost scaling with identity count, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
